exposure.needed: whether cert-manager is installed and upgraded from an OperatorHub package (RedHat OpenShift OperatorHub or operatorhub.io)

assertion.statement: From 1.17.0, cert-manager no longer publishes OperatorHub packages, so v1.16.5 is the last release on OperatorHub (both RedHat OpenShift OperatorHub and operatorhub.io).

proposal.undeterminedReason: consequence: The evidence says v1.16.5 is the last OperatorHub release. It does not say what happens to existing OperatorHub installations or what operators should do instead.
